Implement solve(xs: list[int]) -> int. Return the length of the longest run of consecutive elements that all share the same parity (all even, or all odd). A single element counts as a run of length 1.

result_summary:
Implement solve(xs: list[int]) -> int. Walk the list left to right. Skip any element divisible by 3. Add the first non-skipped element, subtract the second, add the third, and so on. The alternation advances only on non-skipped elements. Return the total.

Write your implementation and verify it bef

args.code:
from solution import solve
cases = [
    ([1,2,3,4,5], -2),
    ([3,6,9], 0),
    ([], 0),
    ([7], 7),
    ([-3,-1,2], -3),
    ([1,3,2,6,4], 1-2+4),  # 3,6 skipped
    ([10, 12, 11, 13], 10-11+13),
    ([3, 1, 2], 1-2),
]
for xs, exp in cases:
    got = solve(xs)
    assert got == exp, (xs, got, exp)
print('all passed')
